brief:
We need a simple website for a small ceramics studio.
The site must show 8 products, photos and a contact form.
The first version should be ready by October 24.
Photos will only be available on October 28.
We do not want a cart or payments for now.
The customer must be able to buy a product online immediately.
We have not yet agreed who will write the product descriptions.
